title: Topic 9
japanese_text: 友達の恋人の<u>浮気</u>現場を目撃し、<u>憤り</u>を感じて2人を追いかけ、声をかけた。しかし、振り向いたら<u>人違い</u>だったことが分かり、<u>平謝りする</u>しかなかった。
english_translation: I witnessed my friend's partner cheating, and feeling outraged, I chased after the two of them and called out to them. However, when she turned around, I saw that I'd mistaken her for someone else and I had to apologize profusely.
